author: NETWORG
name: Power Platform: Plugin
description: Creates a Dataverse plugin project: PluginBase.cs (abstract IPlugin with _context, _organizationService, _tracingService, calls abstract OnExecute()). CHAIN: Step 1 — create project. Step 2 — reference it from a pp-solution project (dotnet add reference): that solution's build registers the assembly itself, no template is needed for it. Step 3 — say when each class runs: with [PluginStep] attributes on the class when the project's build SDK supports them (using TALXIS.DevKit.Build.Dataverse.Plugin compiles), otherwise with pp-plugin-assembly-step. Individual plugin classes extend PluginBase.cs in the same project.

PublisherName.description: Publisher name for the plugin project (used as author in PAC CLI)

Company.description: Company name for the plugin project metadata

PluginBaseType.description: Select the type of PluginBase class to use

SigningKeyFilePath.description: Path to the signing key file for plugin assembly signing (optional)
